en.Charm_S1A_SharpLeaf_Desc:
A sharp leaf plucked by Ant Colony.

Slightly increases weapon damage.
en.Charm_S1B_RedHeart_Desc:
A red, lively heart.

Grants one extra health limit.
en.Charm_S1C_Exoskeleton_Desc:
A defensive armor used by the ants.

Gains exoskeleton charges by staying close to enemy projectiles. When charging is complete, the exoskeleton can absorb one damage from enemies.
